name: big_nav3
description: Three cars in the 22 x 16 m exploration lab (~/isaac_worlds/big_env: four rooms, a cross corridor and outer galleries; loops of 20, 24.5 and 49 m), each with its own SLAM and Nav2. The 'spread' start set: 16-18 m apart along paths, walls between them, so the robots meet late. The test environment from 15 Oct 2026.
planner_params_note: classic_planner parameters for this world: active loop closing keeps the paper's distances (2.5 / 6 / 20 m; the room scales them by 0.3): the lab has loops of 20-49 m
